versions.name: Eagle Base @ Heritage Reservation

features.note: Participants complete an ATV safety e-course before riding.
The Day Trek programme, a different off-site adventure each day, for Scouts fourteen and older.

versions.summary: High-adventure Day Trek program at Heritage Reservation, offering older Scouts BSA off-site adventure beyond merit badges.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). Only the Eagle Base section of that page was used; several of its activities happen off-property on the day treks.
